journal_entries_posted_fields_chk.name: journal_entries_posted_fields_chk
journal_entries_posted_fields_chk.value: "journal_entries"."status" in ('draft', 'cancelled') or ("journal_entries"."doc_no" is not null and "journal_entries"."period_id" is not null and "journal_entries"."posted_at" is not null and "journal_entries"."posted_by" is not null)

journal_entries_source_all_or_none_chk.name: journal_entries_source_all_or_none_chk
journal_entries_source_all_or_none_chk.value: ("journal_entries"."source_type" is null) = ("journal_entries"."source_id" is null) and ("journal_entries"."source_type" is null) = ("journal_entries"."source_event" is null)

journal_entries_cancel_fields_chk.name: journal_entries_cancel_fields_chk
journal_entries_cancel_fields_chk.value: "journal_entries"."status" <> 'cancelled' or ("journal_entries"."cancelled_at" is not null and "journal_entries"."reason" is not null)

approval_workflow_steps_approver_chk.name: approval_workflow_steps_approver_chk
approval_workflow_steps_approver_chk.value: ("approval_workflow_steps"."approver_role_id" is not null) <> ("approval_workflow_steps"."approver_user_id" is not null)

approval_workflows_amount_chk.name: approval_workflows_amount_chk
approval_workflows_amount_chk.value: "approval_workflows"."min_amount" is null or "approval_workflows"."max_amount" is null or "approval_workflows"."min_amount" <= "approval_workflows"."max_amount"
